title: New regional DC in the North West
business_case: Adds 400k sq ft of regional capacity to relieve Northampton and Daventry
key_assumptions: Volume growth 6% a year; 15-month build; land secured at current price
sensitivity_10pct: NPV falls to about GBP 0.4m and payback stretches to 8 years under a 10% revenue miss
description: Adds 400k sq ft of regional capacity to relieve Northampton and Daventry

title: Store refit programme, 60 stores
business_case: Refit 60 high-street and retail-park stores to the new format
key_assumptions: Like-for-like sales uplift of 6% in refitted stores; 4-week closure per store
sensitivity_10pct: NPV falls to about GBP 3.1m under a 10% revenue miss; payback 5.0 years
description: Refit 60 high-street and retail-park stores to the new format

title: E-commerce platform and fulfilment capacity
business_case: Replace the checkout and payments platform and add pick capacity for online orders
key_assumptions: Online share of sales reaches 28% in two years; conversion up 0.4 points
sensitivity_10pct: NPV falls to about GBP 4.6m under a 10% revenue miss; payback 4.2 years
description: Replace the checkout and payments platform and add pick capacity for online orders

title: Nearshoring: Turkey and Portugal supplier hubs
business_case: Move 15% of apparel and home volume to nearshore suppliers to cut lead time by 5 weeks
key_assumptions: Landed cost within 3% of Far East; 20 suppliers qualified in 18 months
sensitivity_10pct: NPV falls to about GBP 2.8m under a 10% revenue miss; payback 4.8 years
description: Move 15% of apparel and home volume to nearshore suppliers to cut lead time by 5 weeks

title: New markets: Poland and Czechia launch
business_case: Launch the home range online and in 12 concession stores in Poland and Czechia
key_assumptions: Brand awareness builds slowly; 35% gross margin after duties; no local entity needed in year one
sensitivity_10pct: NPV turns negative at about GBP -0.6m under a 10% revenue miss; payback 7.1 years
description: Launch the home range online and in 12 concession stores in Poland and Czechia

title: Network automation: Daventry and Leeds DCs
business_case: Goods-to-person picking at Daventry and Leeds to cut labour cost per unit
key_assumptions: Labour saving of GBP 2.4m a year from month 15; 12-month build
sensitivity_10pct: NPV falls to about GBP 2.0m under a 10% revenue miss; payback 5.3 years
description: Goods-to-person picking at Daventry and Leeds to cut labour cost per unit

title: Northampton DC automation (shuttle storage and goods-to-person)
business_case: Automate storage and picking at Northampton DC to cut labour cost per unit; about £3.4m a year saving once live
key_assumptions: £3.4m annual saving from go-live; 10-year asset life; 10% discount rate; payback counted from first spend; 12-month build with no slip
sensitivity_10pct: A 10% volume miss cuts volume-linked savings: NPV falls to about £5.86m and payback lengthens to 4.9 years
description: Proposed £12m automation investment at Northampton DC
